rules.title: Secrets are not embedded in tracked artifacts
rules.description: Plans, handoffs, audit logs, documentation, and AI context reference secret identifiers rather than copying credentials or tokens.
rules.rationale: A secret committed once is compromised permanently, and removing it from HEAD does not remove it from history.
rules.remediation: Replace the value with a secret-store reference, then rotate the credential.
rules.$assuranceNote: A structural scan establishes that no secret was OBVIOUSLY embedded. It MUST NOT be reported as 'no secrets present' (Standard 24 R3).
